body:
**Scope:** stand up the new **`metadata-tikv`** crate — a sibling of `metadata-redb`, depending **only on `traits`** (plus `tikv-client` and `tokio`), implementing `MetadataStore` over TiKV's transactional API (`crates/traits/src/lib.rs:173-187`; ADR-0016 dependency rule). Skeleton implements the basic `get` / `scan` / `commit` shapes; a **throwaway single-node TiKV in `deploy/`** lets CI reach a real store. Run the **existing** (shared, not forked) `MetadataStore` conformance suite that redb passes against TiKV for the `get`/`scan`/`commit` basics. Pin the `tikv-client` version in `Cargo.toml` (see Open questions) and confirm its futures are `Send + Sync` for the object-safe trait.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] `metadata-tikv` crate exists, deps = `traits` + `tikv-client` + `tokio` only (never `core` or another concrete)
- [ ] TiKV passes the **shared** (not forked) `MetadataStore` conformance suite for the basic operations
- [ ] CI can reach a TiKV (throwaway single-node in `deploy/`)
- [ ] `tikv-client` version pinned; `cargo-deny` passes with the new dependency tree (ADR-0003)

**Needs:** trait confirmed frozen (slice can begin in parallel with the tail of M3). **Refs:** proposal 0007 §"Crate touch-points", §"Suggested PR sequence" (1); ADR-0008, ADR-0016. Branch `feat/m4.1-metadata-tikv-skeleton`, commit `feat(metadata-tikv): … (M4.1, #<issue>)`.

milestone.title: M4 — Production metadata backend
milestone.description: Step 2. Swap embedded redb for distributed TiKV behind the unchanged MetadataStore trait; multi-key atomic directory ops hold under the distributed store. Completes the single-zone data plane — a soft stopping point, not the release: the ★ Step-2 release point is M8 (proposal 0013 implementation arc, supersedes 0002). Plan: proposal 0007; tracker #201; first-deployment gate #367.

title: M4.1 — metadata-tikv crate skeleton + run the shared MetadataStore conformance suite against TiKV
